headline: Milan, October of protests: five dates already scheduled for strikes, here is when
summary: Five strike dates have been set for October in Milan. The railway sector's work stoppage runs from 11 to 14 October, with other sectors including schools, local authorities and healthcare also involved.
why: Strikes in rail and public services disrupt commuter transport and public operations, and labour disputes can affect Italian economic activity.
